basic_info.description: Rarely available single-level two-bedroom ranch-style home in the highly sought after Forest Hill neighborhood of San Francisco. Upon entry, you are greeted with an open living room & spacious dining room. This home exudes modern comfort with newly refinished floors, fresh interior paint & plantation window shutters. The large 4,525 sqft lot offers ADU possibilities, extending all the way to Magellan Street, providing ample space for expansion or customization. The updated kitchen painted in modern designer colors, opens to the yard & the updated bath enhances the home's appeal. The long driveway, perfect for up to two full-size vehicles in addition to a large garage offers convenience. With minimal steps at the front & only two in the back, this home offers easy accessibility. Centrally located just a block from Forest Hill Station, commuting to downtown & all areas in San Francisco is a breeze. You'll be near vibrant West Portal, with renowned cafs, restaurants & elegant wine bars, including Elena's, Little Original Joe's, Starbucks & Peet's Enjoy proximity to UCSF, GG Park & Twin Peaks, making this location ideal for both relaxation & city life. Experience the best of San Francisco living in this beautifully updated home, offering space & convenience in an unbeatable location
